Train one Cubist + PCA(120) model for a single soil property

Source: R/cubist_baseline.R
train_cubist_pca.Rd

Faithful to Safanelli 2025: PCA(120) on SNV-preprocessed spectra, optional log1p target transform, Cubist with inner-CV committee tuning, Q-statistic UCL on training residuals, normalised-conformal calibration for prediction intervals.

Usage

train_cubist_pca(
  X,
  y,
  family_id,
  prop,
  out_dir = "models",
  n_components = 120L,
  committees_grid = .CUBIST_COMMITTEE_GRID,
  k_inner = 5L,
  inner_subset_n = 2000L,
  min_n = 50L
)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix of preprocessed (SNV) spectra

y

Numeric target vector

family_id

Family ID (e.g. "OSSL_VisNIR_Cubist")

prop

Soil property name

out_dir

Output root (default "models")

n_components

PCA components (default 120)

committees_grid

Cubist committee values to tune

k_inner

Inner-CV folds for tuning (default 5)

inner_subset_n

Subsample for tuning (default 2000)

min_n

Minimum samples to attempt training (default 50)

Value

Invisible TRUE on success, NULL on skip
